data.name: Fairy Hotel - Enchanted Kingdom
data.detailed_description:
Maya's ordinary life takes a wild turn when she's kidnapped to Fairyland by a spoiled yet devilishly handsome prince trying to secure his claim to the throne. To prove he's worthy, he needs to build something impressive for the king, but instead of doing the work himself, he puts Maya in charge.

Now stuck in a world of fairies, mythical creatures, mushroom groves, and unpredictable enchantments, Maya has to restore and manage steamy onsens, mushroom hotels, and fairy palaces while juggling magical guests, enchanted creatures, and royal demands to earn her freedom. The more she takes on, the more she discovers about herself and the strange magic surrounding her.

Tackle 60 fast-paced Time Management levels, unlock magical upgrades, play challenging mini-games, and collect diary pages that reveal hidden secrets. With charming characters and beautifully whimsical locations, this is a tale of unexpected strength, magical chaos, and turning pressure into purpose.

FEATURES:

🏨 Magical Hotel Management

Manage check-ins, deliver creature comforts, and ensure every guest leaves happy.

🏨 60 Story-Packed Levels

Tackle fast-paced Time Management levels packed with multitasking and magic.

🏨 Enchanted Locations

Restore 6 whimsical hotels in glowing forests, floating palaces, and steamy onsens.

🏨 Mini-Games & Collectibles

Play magical mini-games, discover hidden diary pages, and collect mystical surprises.

🏨 Menu Upgrades

Enhance your offerings to boost scores, improve patience, and delight demanding guests.

🏨 Breathtaking Art

Explore rich, intricate fantasy-themed visuals with cottagecore charm.

🏨 Quirky Characters

Meet mythical creatures, talking frogs, and royal fairies with big personalities.

🏨 Maya's Journey

Join Maya as she finds confidence, purpose, and unexpected magic.
